outcome: presence of vancomycin resistance genes (van A, van B)
cohort: Patients at Tlemcen Hospital in Algeria from whom Enterococcus spp was isolated
finding: This work revealed alarming levels of antibiotic resistance in Enterococci, the vanA gene was found in two E. faecium; sequencing of this gene has revealed a total homology with another isolated in Cuba, which demonstrates a worldwide spread of this resistance gene.
